title: NO ONE TOO YOUNG OR TOO OLD

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Assemble the people — men, women and children, and the foreigners residing in your towns — so they can listen and learn to fear the Lord your God and follow carefully all the words of this law. Their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the Lord your God as long as you live in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess." — Deut 31:12-13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Notice who was to be gathered to hear God's Word: everyone. Men, women, children, and even the foreigners living among them. No one was excluded — not the smallest child, not the outsider, not the elderly. God wanted His Word to reach every heart in the community, and especially the next generation: "their children, who do not know this law, must hear it and learn to fear the Lord."

God's heart for children shines here. He did not consider them too young to hear His Word. On the contrary, He specifically commanded that the children hear it and learn to fear Him. Faith is meant to be passed down deliberately, from one generation to the next. Children are not an afterthought in God's family; they are precious and included.

This is a wonderful encouragement for families. Parents and grandparents, take heart: teaching your children God's Word matters deeply to Him. The everyday moments of sharing Scripture, praying together, and speaking of the Lord are part of God's own design for passing on faith.

Jesus welcomed the little ones with open arms, saying, "Let the little children come to me" (Mark 10:14). No one is too young to begin knowing God, and no one is too old or too far outside to be included. Whatever your age or place in life, God's Word is for you — and He calls us to make sure it reaches the next generation too. Gather around it, and pass it on.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I believe no one is too young to begin knowing God?
2. Am I helping pass faith on to the next generation?
3. Who in my life — young or old — could I help bring closer to God's Word?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that Your Word is for everyone, young and old, insider and outsider. Help me learn to fear You, and give me a heart to pass on faith to the next generation. Amen.
